learnings: Transient API errors on non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the executable packaging files (PKGBUILD) are verified safe. The tool should either retry the failed request or gracefully degrade to a 'safe' verdict when only metadata files fail to parse.
